candidate_sources.README.md:
# Hotel incident worksheet


The workspace API drives a document editor and its save badge. The workspace store
holds draft text across navigation and closed editor views. Returning to a document
restores the user's last edit. Save integrations receive committed records and may
select another document synchronously. Later navigation means the navigation request that starts later takes precedence, even if an earlier request returns afterward. For example, if open(B) starts and saving the departed A invokes a callback that calls open(C), C remains selected after the callback and the outer open(B) return. If that callback calls close() instead, the editor remains closed after the outer open(B) returns. These are navigation results, independent of when the departed document's save occurs.
When close/open returns, the departed document's last accepted edit is available
through the store, even if the next view selects a different document.

`createSearchPreview` is an adjacent transient search panel. It publishes after a
40 ms quiet interval; hiding it discards an unpublished query. It can be reused.

The public methods are synchronous. Output render functions observe state; navigation
comes through the workspace API, including its `onSaved` integration. `store` provides
`read`, `write` and `subscribe`; `timers` provides `schedule(callback, delay)` and
`cancel(handle)`. Production timers use the browser's timers. Keep these interfaces.

candidate_sources.docs/host-api.md:
# Host integration

open(id), edit(text), close() and dispose() are synchronous entry points.
The store owns persisted document records independently of any mounted view.
Store delivery writes first, snapshots subscriptions, and skips removed listeners.
onSaved is called inline and can navigate or edit; rendering is an output sink.
Every open creates a fresh visit and subscription, including same-key reopen.
Injected timers provide schedule(callback,delay) and cancel(handle).
The preview is transient and independent of the editor's persistence policy.
candidate_sources.src/workflow.php:
<?php
class Store {
    private $records, $listeners = [], $serial = 0, $revision = 0;
    function __construct($records) { $this->records = $records; }
    function read($id) { return $this->records[$id] ?? ''; }
    function subscribe($fn) { $token = ++$this->serial; $this->listeners[$token] = $fn; return $token; }
    function stop($token) { unset($this->listeners[$token]); }
    function write($id, $text) {
        $this->records[$id] = $text;
        $event = ['id'=>$id, 'text'=>$text, 'revision'=>++$this->revision];
        foreach ($this->listeners as $token=>$fn) if (isset($this->listeners[$token])) $fn($event);
        return $event;
    }
}
class Trailing {
    private $env, $delay, $work, $handle = null, $pending = null;
    function __construct($env, $delay, $work) { $this->env=$env; $this->delay=$delay; $this->work=$work; }
    function push($value) {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $this->pending=$value;
        $this->handle=$this->env->schedule(function() { $this->flush(); }, $this->delay);
    }
    function flush() {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $value=$this->pending; $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;
        if ($value !== null) ($this->work)($value);
    }
    function cancel() {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;
    }
}

class Visit {
    private $env, $id, $stop, $task;
    function __construct($env, $id) {
        $this->env=$env; $this->id=$id;
        $token=$env->store->subscribe(function($e) use ($env, $id) { if ($e['id']===$id) $env->output('status',$e); });
        $this->stop=function() use ($env, $token) { $env->store->stop($token); };
        $this->task=new Trailing($env,120,function($text) use ($env,$id) { $env->write($id,$text); });
    }
    function accept($text) { $this->task->push($text); }
    function depart() { ($this->stop)();$this->env->output('document',null);$this->task->flush(); }
}
class Workspace {
    private $env, $current=null, $generation=0;
    function __construct($env) { $this->env=$env; }
    private function retire() { $old=$this->current; $this->current=null; if ($old) $old->depart(); else $this->env->output('document',null); }
    function open($id) { $ticket=++$this->generation; $this->retire(); if ($ticket!==$this->generation) return; $this->current=new Visit($this->env,$id); $this->env->output('document',['id'=>$id,'text'=>$this->env->store->read($id)]); }
    function edit($text) { $selected=$this->current; if ($selected) $selected->accept($text); }
    function close() { ++$this->generation; $this->retire(); }
    function dispose() { $this->close(); }
}
class Preview {
    private $task;
    function __construct($env) { $this->task=new Trailing($env,40,function($q) use ($env) { $env->output('preview',['query'=>$q]); }); }
    function query($text) { $this->task->push($text); }
    function hide() { $this->task->cancel(); }
}
